stimulus.body: The working note below records the evidence for a claim about foreshadowing planted and paid off in a passage. the early flow in May is what makes the stored honey possible in August, so the later passage delivers the consequence the earlier one set up. A marginal reminder adds: ask what the May flow has to do with August. A reader must decide which of the four proposed statements the note warrants, without using outside knowledge.
